title: Staff and officials – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Staff and official assignments
hero.lead: These two Kaderblick administration areas assign a user a specific function in a team or club. The function and validity period determine where and in which capacity the account is recorded.

body:
Staff assignments

The Team staff and Club staff tabs show their assignment counts. Each row shows the user, team or club, staff function, start, end and actions. Examples in the demo include equipment manager, bus driver, media officer, physiotherapist and team manager.

Official assignments

The Team officials and Club officials tabs use the same structure. Examples in the demo include parent representative, youth officer, team captain, match captain and cashier.

Create an assignment

  1. Select the Team or Club tab and then Add assignment.
  2. Select the user and the team or club. Both are required.
  3. Optionally select a function from the function types available for that level.
  4. If required, define the validity period under From and To.
  5. Select Save. The button remains disabled while the user or team/club is missing.

Edit and delete

The pencil opens the user, scope, function and validity period of the existing assignment. The bin opens a confirmation prompt; only Delete removes the assignment.

Effects on other areas

  • The assignment appears on the account under Users and assignments.
  • A function can enable specialised areas: a cashier, for example, works with the Cashbook and My balance, while an equipment manager works with the Inventory.
  • Team assignments apply to a specific team; club assignments apply to the club. Start and end limit their validity.
